notes.title: Project Mist Multiplayer and new release window - Q3 2025
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’ve got an important update about the Early Access launch of Project Mist. While we were originally aiming to release in May, we’ve decided to delay the launch by a few months.

Our initial plan was to release without multiplayer and introduce it later during Early Access. But after a lot of internal discussion — and listening to your feedback — we’ve decided to hold off and launch with multiplayer right from the start.

It wasn’t an easy call, but we truly believe it's the right one. Multiplayer is a huge part of the Project Mist experience, and launching without it just wouldn’t feel complete. We’d rather take the extra time now than compromise on something this important.

Since the demo launched, we’ve been hard at work making improvements across the board — visuals, performance, AI behavior, combat feel, UI/UX, new bosses, new enemies, new items, mechanics and a ton more. The feedback we received from the demo has been incredibly valuable, and it’s helped us level up the game in ways we’re really excited about.

We know delays are never fun to hear about, but this extra time is going directly into making Project Mist better. We genuinely can’t wait to share the updated version with you and we hope that it’ll be worth the wait.

The Project Mist Team

notes.title: Project Mist Demo is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Players,[/h3]
We are beyond excited to announce that we have reached a huge milestone:

[h2]The Project Mist demo is now live! [/h2]

First and foremost, we want to thank you for your incredible patience, support, and belief in our journey so far. We are so happy to see that over [b]72 000 players already wishlisted [/b]our game which is way beyond what we have expected! As the demo is now in your hands, we’re eager to see what are your thoughts and feedback!

[b]To download demo just follow our main game page or this link:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025940/Project_Mist_Demo/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025940/Project_Mist_Demo/[/url][/b]

[h2]A few important things to note:[/h2]

💡 This demo is an [b]alpha build[/b], which means it’s still very much a work-in-progress. Expect a lot of [b]bugs, performance issues, some crashes and temporary solutions[/b] scattered throughout the game. These are normal at this stage, but we are committed to improving with your help.

Also please note that we are just a small studio from Poland with only 10 people working on this project but we are dedicated to make it great for you in the next upcoming months!

[h2]Your feedback:[/h2]

We truly value your thoughts and feedback as we want to make a best experience tailored to your needs! Please let us know:

What do you like about this demo?
What do you dislike?
What features or improvements would you like to see?
Your insights will help us shape the future of Project Mist and make it the best it can be.

It would mean a lot to us if you could finish this short questionnaire to help us better understand your needs:
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1ZEL8AlkvlI5EL7AcunXnsLmv73eUe7vKcoqikDimmN8/]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1ZEL8AlkvlI5EL7AcunXnsLmv73eUe7vKcoqikDimmN8/[/url]

[h2]Also a quick info regarding Language Editions:[/h2]
🌍 At the moment, the demo is only available in English. But don’t worry – we’re working hard to bring you additional languages in time for the Steam Next Fest, which kicks off in less than two weeks!

Sincerely,
The Project Mist Team

notes.content:

[h2][b]Brace yourselves, fellow Survivors! [/b][/h2]

Another update is on the horizon, pulsating with fresh thrills and horrors straight from the depths of our studio. Do you have what it takes to make it out alive? Take a look at the upcoming mayhem:

[previewyoutube=wyOnXqLtaBU;full][/previewyoutube]

🔥 Unleash Chaos with Dynamic Destruction: Now, you hold the reins of chaos in your hands! Tear down wooden structures and bridges piece by piece, whether you're seeking refuge or causing a ruckus. The choice is yours.

⛏️ Delve Deeper with Full Destruction Mining: Embark on a dark journey with our revamped mining system. Chip away at deposits bit by bit, revealing precious ores hidden within the shadows. Race against time and terror to unearth resources that fuel your survival.

🔫 Embrace the Power of the Gravity Gun: Manipulate nature like never before! Hurl objects at your foes, fortify your base effortlessly, or indulge in some twisted gardening with the gravity gun. Endless possibilities await, but so do the dangers.

🏰 Strengthen Your Defenses with Bunkers and Traps: Outsmart the shadows with an array of new defenses. From fortified bunkers to sly traps, fortify your base and fend off the relentless horrors lurking in the shadows.

📸 Exclusive First-Glimpse Map Screenshots: As a token of our gratitude for your unwavering support, take a peek into the heart of our twisted world. Feast your eyes on eerie landscapes and ominous structures, but beware - what you see may linger in your dreams forever.

Surviving in this realm demands courage, and with these new tools at your disposal, you might just tip the odds in your favor. For now - keep your wits about you, stay alive, and be ready for more updates from the lurking darkness! 🌑

[h2]Your feedback is worth its weight in gold to us![/h2]

Our goal is to create a game that both you and we will eagerly immerse ourselves in for dozens of hours. Therefore, every comment, every observation, every good idea is highly valued by us. So, if you are already here, if you liked what you just saw, or perhaps, on the contrary, if you didn't like it, we will be grateful if you fill out this short survey because it is thanks to you that this game has the chance to become better with each iteration.

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1xAMYSJfzoqgdHmLR-tX03lumXjPZykOy0RewGBM3L8c/]FEEDBACK SURVEY[/url]
